Explore the story, power, and deeper meaning of Mahakali through a spiritual journey across Kalighat Temple, Dakshineswar Kali Temple, and Belur Math in Kolkata.

From the story of Raktabija and Maa Kali standing on Lord Shiva, to the devotion of Ramakrishna Paramhansa, this documentary explores Shakti Upasana, Shakta tradition, Kali Puja, Durga Puja, Tantra, bhakti, meditation, and Sanatan Dharma.

It also touches on themes connected to Raktabija & Shukracharya, Shakti Peethas, spiritual awakening, Maa Durga, Swami Vivekananda, and Indian spirituality.

A journey to understand why Mahakali is not just fierce, but also a powerful symbol of love, protection, and transformation.

Jai Maa Kali. 🙏

#mahakali #kolkata

Our first episode with the  TRS All-Star Rajarshi Nandy was a blockbuster and it's just the beginning. A "TRS all-star" is a term my team and I are incredibly cautious of using, as said in the introduction of the video, Rajarshi Nandy was a guest whom I can vouch for. In this stellar episode of The Ranveer Show, we explained the dark tantra - Satanism, Demons & Kundalini Jagran. He is someone who has an ocean of knowledge and experience, the clarity of his knowledge is truly incredible.

Shri Rajarshi Nandy is a Sadhaka par excellence and an adherent of the Sanatan Dharma. He is a speaker, columnist, and author of Hindu spiritual practices. He has co-authored a paper named "Tantra and Modern Neuroscience:  Is there any co-relation?" which was published in Neurology India magazine. ..  Based on experiences and interactions with different Yogis and Sadhaks, the book also contains an exploration of some common and uncommon deities from various branches of Hinduism.

Please feel free to drop your thoughts about the podcast on any of our socials, what other topics you would like for us to cover, guest suggestions, and anything you would want us to improve on. My team and I are always looking for your feedback. Thank you for all the support.

(0:00) - Rajarshi x Ranveer Begins
(3:22) - Higher beings: Tantra Explanation
(5:27) - What do you mean by a deity?
(6:05) - What are astral and causal bodies?
(10:14) - What is the constitution of the body?
(11:07) - What is the meaning & purpose of Kundalini?
(21:44) - What is the downside of Kundalini?
(24:43) - What is the reality of the movie “Kantara”
(36:16) - Ambika Devi’s experience
(38:38) - What is satan’s & demon’s effect on our mind?
(46:23) - Experience on the movie “Hereditary”
(48:33) - Western version of dark entities & Asura
(55:09) - Burari Death Case
(57:03) - Exorcist experience
(1:04:29) - What is the causal body?
(1:11:30) - Saints & monks in the Himalayas
(1:18:25) - What is the devil?
(1:21:37) - Thank you for watching

#demon #satanism
